title: IBS Design Engineer
description:
* ***Key Responsibilities:***

· Design and develop in\-building wireless solutions using iBwave Design Tool  
· Create wireless coverage designs for various venue sizes (large, medium, small) using Active, Passive, and Hybrid solutions  
· Analyze and optimize designs to meet client needs  
· Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (PMs, RF engineers, etc.)  
· Prepare detailed design reports and documentation  
· Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices  
· Troubleshoot technical issues related to wireless networks

* ***Qualifications:***

· Bachelor's degree/Diploma in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or related field  
· 2\-3 years of experience with iBwave Design and wireless solutions  
· Strong knowledge of RF design principles, DAS, and small cell systems  
· Proficiency in AutoCAD, Excel, and other relevant software  
· Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills  
· Certifications in iBwave Design (preferred)

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* 4Years: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
